questions.prompt: What is the ready guard at the start of Wansu?
choices: Left hand open with the right fist on top

questions.prompt: What is the first movement?
choices: Turn 45 degrees left, low block and straight punch on that line

questions.prompt: At step 3 the open hand side block is followed by what?
choices: A finger thrust (nukite) to the body, then the hand covers

questions.prompt: What footwork sets up the angle punch at steps 4 and 7?
choices: Stepping behind, one foot behind the other, to move off line

questions.prompt: What do the hands do just before the dump?
choices: They stack in front of the torso

questions.prompt: What happens at steps 8 and 9?
choices: A small body shift to avoid a punch, then a straight punch and an angle punch

questions.prompt: Why is Wansu called the 'dumping kata'?
choices: Because it ends by dumping the hands
Because of its signature body slam or throw near the middle
Because it drops into low stances

questions.prompt: What does the nukite at step 3 aim at?
choices: A soft target such as the solar plexus, neck or groin

questions.prompt: The 'avoid, straight punch, angle punch' idea at steps 8, 9 and 16 teaches what?
choices: Get out of the way first, then hit, then hit a secondary target

questions.prompt: What do the knee lifts at steps 14 and 15 add after the side block and punch?
choices: A knee strike, or a stomp depending on the teacher

questions.prompt: The front kicks at step 10 serve what purpose?
choices: A forward entry to stop an advancing attacker

questions.prompt: Where do the kiai in Wansu usually fall?
choices: On the dump and on the final strong strikes

questions.prompt: How does the pace of Wansu change?
choices: Medium pace with explosive bursts on the dump and the kicking combinations
It is all as fast as possible
It speeds up steadily to the end

questions.prompt: What does 'off-line' mean in Wansu's angular entries?
choices: Stepping to an angle so you are no longer on the attacker's line of attack

questions.prompt: What is the hardest balance moment in Wansu?
choices: Loading the opponent onto the hip or shoulder and pivoting for the dump, then setting the stance

questions.prompt: Why does Wansu get called the 'strong arm form'?
choices: Its strong linear punches and blocks

questions.prompt: Which style did Wansu come into Isshin Ryu from?
Who is the kata traditionally said to be named after?
choices: A Chinese envoy to Okinawa, Wang Ji (Wanshu)

questions.prompt: When is Wansu usually taught?
choices: As a mid-level kata, often after Naihanchi

questions.prompt: In the viewer, several late steps are marked 'reconstructed'. What does that mean?
choices: They were rebuilt from lineage descriptions rather than complete notes, and your dojo's version rules
